fields.Name: T81 - Forums Thread Posts
fields.Description: Opens a Forum Thread record (not a Forum Category).

InputDefinition.goal: In the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, type 'Forum Threads' and open the entity named exactly 'Forum Threads' (NOT 'Forum Categories' — if both appear in the results, choose 'Forum Threads'). In the Forum Threads grid, click directly on a row's Title text (a discussion title such as 'Help! My cheese is too crumbly'), then click 'Open Full Record'. Do NOT click any Category name or link inside the row. Verify a Forum Thread record form is displayed with thread fields (Title, Status, view/reply counts). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Forum Threads entity grid was opened (not Forum Categories)
A forum thread record form is displayed with its thread fields
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
